source_name: NiMet (Oyo State Meteorological Manager Emmanuel Udoh, Ibadan, March 2026)
note: NiMet defines onset as soil moisture reaching 50%. NIHORT summary of NiMet downscaled Oyo forecast notes wider onset mid-April to early May with advice to wait 10 to 15 days after confirmed onset before planting (https://nihort.gov.ng/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/Seasonal-Climate-Prediction-2026.pdf).
